responsibility: This header declares the public interface to gfortran’s backend type-construction layer. It exports the canonical tree nodes for fundamental Fortran runtime types and pointers, flags describing real-kind correspondence to long double/_Float128, and the builders/query helpers for Fortran scalar types, character types, symbol and function types, array and CFI descriptors, dtype values, struct-field insertion, and layout decisions used by the various trans-* lowering files.
same_name_distinction: Declares the backend type-construction interface and exports canonical type nodes, kind-correlation flags, and builders/query helpers for Fortran scalar, character, symbol, function, array, and descriptor types. Unlike gcc/fortran/trans-types.cc, it is the shared declaration layer, not the implementation of type layout and initialization.
